name: Grain Carry Regime Persistence
description: Tests whether backwardation vs contango in corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS) predicts the carry regime one quarter (63 trading days) ahead. Uses futures_continuation carry signal — positive = backwardation, negative = contango. Scatter shows current carry vs 63-day forward carry to reveal persistence. Summary stats show hit rate (% of days where carry sign persists) and median forward carry by regime.
source:
# Grain Carry Regime Persistence
# Does backwardation/contango in corn & soybeans persist next quarter?
# Carry > 0 = backwardation (front > back), Carry < 0 = contango

# --- Data ---
ts = index()().value
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry

# --- Forward carry (63 trading days ≈ 1 quarter) ---
# Use << operator, NOT forward_returns (carry can cross zero → division by zero)
fwd_carry_63 = carry << 63

# --- Regime classification ---
is_backwardation = is_valid(carry) and carry > 0
is_contango = is_valid(carry) and carry < 0

# --- Forward carry filtered by current regime ---
bwd_fwd = where(is_backwardation, fwd_carry_63)
ctg_fwd = where(is_contango, fwd_carry_63)

# --- Persistence: did carry keep the same sign? ---
# Hit = 1.0 if forward carry has same sign as current carry, else 0.0
bwd_hit = 1.0 if (is_backwardation and is_valid(fwd_carry_63) and fwd_carry_63 > 0) else 0.0
bwd_hit_filtered = where(is_backwardation and is_valid(fwd_carry_63), bwd_hit)

ctg_hit = 1.0 if (is_contango and is_valid(fwd_carry_63) and fwd_carry_63 < 0) else 0.0
ctg_hit_filtered = where(is_contango and is_valid(fwd_carry_63), ctg_hit)

# --- Event markers: regime flips ---
enter_bwd = is_backwardation and not (is_valid(carry >> 1) and (carry >> 1) > 0)
enter_ctg = is_contango and not (is_valid(carry >> 1) and (carry >> 1) < 0)
is_flip = enter_bwd or enter_ctg
regime_label = "Backwardation" if enter_bwd else "Contango"

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Carry Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry, regime_label, cont.c, is_flip)

# --- Chart 1: Scatter — carry now vs carry in 63d ---
# The punchline: if dots cluster along the diagonal, carry persists
xy_scatter(
    title='Does Current Carry Predict Next Quarter Carry?',
    x_axis_label='Current Carry',
    y_axis_label='Carry in 63 Trading Days',
    category='Carry Persistence',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=4,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=carry, y_values=fwd_carry_63)

# --- Chart 2: Bars — median forward carry by regime ---
# Backwardation vs contango: which regime produces higher forward carry?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Median Forward Carry by Current Regime',
    y_axis_label='Median Carry in 63d',
    category='Carry Persistence',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(bwd_fwd, ctg_fwd))

# --- Chart 3: Summary table — regime persistence stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry Regime Persistence Stats (63d Forward)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['N (Days)', 'Hit Rate (Same Sign)', 'Median Fwd Carry', 'Worst Fwd Carry'],
        col_headers=['Backwardation', 'Contango'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry Persistence',
    order=0
)(bwd_fwd, ctg_fwd, bwd_hit_filtered, ctg_hit_filtered, bwd_fwd, ctg_fwd, bwd_fwd, ctg_fwd)
